Modern corporate SaaS aesthetic (Coursera, Udemy Business, Linear, Stripe polish).

Layout & Page Structure:
1. Header Section:
- Breadcrumb: Home > Student Portal > My Courses
- Page Title: 'My Courses' (h1, bold slate-900, Inter font)
- Subtitle: 'Track your ongoing curriculum, resume lessons, and download earned executive certifications.'
- Quick KPI stat row or summary badges: '3 Active Courses' | '2 Completed' | '86.4 hrs Total Learned' | '2 Certificates Earned'

2. Controls & Filter Bar:
- Filter Tabs with pill counts:
  * 'All (5)' (styled active or inactive)
  * 'In Progress (3)' (active state with indigo pill badge)
  * 'Completed (2)'
  * 'Archived (0)'
- Right side controls:
  * Search enrolled courses input with search icon
  * Sort dropdown ('Recently Accessed', 'Progress: High to Low', 'Course Name')
  * View toggle (Grid view icon active, List view icon inactive)

3. Course Grid (2x3 or 3x2 responsive grid of rounded-xl cards with subtle border border-slate-200/80, white bg, soft shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition):
Enrolled course cards specifications:
Card 1 (In Progress, High Progress):
- Thumbnail: Advanced Excel Masterclass (financial modeling spreadsheet interface on MacBook)
- Level Badge: 'Advanced' (soft red/rose badge), Category: 'Financial Modeling'
- Title: 'Advanced Excel Masterclass: Dynamic Arrays & Financial Modeling'
- Instructor: 'CA Rohan Mehta' with verified checkmark
- Progress Section:
  * Top text: '68% complete' (bold slate-800) and '21 of 31 lessons' (slate-500)
  * Progress Bar: indigo-600 smooth rounded bar (68% width)
- Metadata: Last accessed '2 hours ago' · Next up: 'Lesson 22: Two-Way Matrix Matching'
- Action CTA: Primary indigo-600 button with white play icon: 'Continue Learning'

Card 2 (In Progress, 'New content added' pill):
- Thumbnail: SQL for Modern Data Analysis (PostgreSQL query editor, database schema diagrams)
- Level Badge: 'Intermediate' (amber badge), Pill: 'New content added' (emerald/teal pill badge with subtle pulse/dot)
- Title: 'SQL for Modern Data Analysis: CTEs, Window Functions & Warehousing'
- Instructor: 'Elena Rostova, Senior Data Engineer'
- Progress Section:
  * '42% complete' · '14 of 33 lessons'
  * Progress Bar: indigo-600 rounded bar (42% width)
- Metadata: Last accessed 'Yesterday' · Next up: 'Lesson 15: Lead/Lag & Moving Aggregates'
- Action CTA: Primary indigo-600 button: 'Continue Learning' with play icon

Card 3 (In Progress):
- Thumbnail: Power Query & Automated ETL Workflows (data ingestion pipeline, M-code editor)
- Level Badge: 'Intermediate' (amber badge)
- Title: 'Power Query & Automated ETL: Enterprise Data Cleansing'
- Instructor: 'Marcus Chen, Principal BI Architect'
- Progress Section:
  * '15% complete' · '4 of 26 lessons'
  * Progress Bar: indigo-600 rounded bar (15% width)
- Metadata: Last accessed '4 days ago' · Next up: 'Lesson 5: Unpivoting Multi-Header Reports'
- Action CTA: Primary indigo-600 button: 'Continue Learning' with play icon

Card 4 (Completed Course Variant):
- Thumbnail: Python for Business Analytics & Dashboards (Jupyter notebook, pandas charts)
- Level Badge: 'Intermediate' (amber badge), Status Badge: 'Completed' (emerald-600 green badge with checkmark)
- Title: 'Python for Business Analytics: Pandas, Automation & Scripting'
- Instructor: 'David Kalu, Head of Data Science'
- Progress Section:
  * '100% complete' · '28 of 28 lessons completed'
  * Progress Bar: emerald-500 full green bar (100% width)
- Metadata: Completed on 'Oct 14, 2024' · Grade: '98% Capstone Distinction'
- Action Section:
  * Outlined button with award/certificate icon: 'View Certificate'
  * Secondary text link: 'Download PDF (.pdf)' with download icon

Card 5 (Completed Course Variant):
- Thumbnail: Executive BI Dashboards with Power BI & Tableau (C-suite executive metrics dashboard)
- Level Badge: 'Advanced' (rose badge), Status Badge: 'Completed' (emerald-600 green badge with checkmark)
- Title: 'Executive BI Dashboards: Board-Ready KPI Storytelling'
- Instructor: 'Rachel Vance, Director of Enterprise BI'
- Progress Section:
  * '100% complete' · '32 of 32 lessons completed'
  * Progress Bar: emerald-500 full green bar (100% width)
- Metadata: Completed on 'Aug 29, 2024' · Credential ID: 'BICE-84920-BI'
- Action Section:
  * Outlined button with award/certificate icon: 'View Certificate'
  * Secondary text link: 'Download PDF (.pdf)' with download icon

Card 6 (Wide or standard card showing 'Recommended Next Step' or empty state preview):
- Style: Dotted or soft slate-100 container card, or clean card showing upcoming enrolled cohort:
- Title: 'Applied Machine Learning for Financial Risk'
- Status: 'Enrolled · Cohort starts Nov 15'
- Details: 'Syllabus available · 0% complete · 0 of 40 lessons'
- Action CTA: Outlined button: 'View Syllabus & Prep Kit'

4. Wide Empty-State / Recommendation Card at bottom:
- Clean card with dashed border or soft slate-50 background (slate-200 border, p-8, rounded-xl text-center):
- Icon: Lucide Compass / GraduationCap / BookOpen icon in indigo-50 circle
- Headline: 'Looking to expand your corporate toolkit?'
- Description: "You're making great progress across data analysis and modeling. Explore 20+ specialized executive cohorts, from Snowflake optimization to Cloud Data Warehousing."
- Action CTA: Indigo primary button: 'Explore Course Catalog' with right arrow

5. Pagination Bar:
- Bottom pagination: 'Showing 5 of 5 enrolled courses' with Previous (disabled), Page '1' (active indigo), Next (disabled).
